knowledge:
- key_parameters:
    - inputFilePath = Path to a FASTA file or a DNAStringSet object containing the input sequences to search for gRNAs.
    - findgRNAs = Logical; defaults to TRUE. Set to FALSE if the input file already contains user-selected gRNAs plus PAM.
    - BSgenomeName = A BSgenome object containing the target genome sequence used for off-target search.
    - genomeSeqFile = Path to a custom target genome file in FASTA format (alternative to BSgenomeName; when set, annotateExon, txdb, and orgAnn are ignored).
    - chromToSearch = Chromosome to search (e.g., "chrX" or "all"). Set to "" to disable off-target search and speed up analysis.
    - max.mismatch = Maximum number of mismatches allowed in off-target search (default 3; values > 3 considerably slow down the search). Set to 0 with a specific chromosome to calculate on-target efficacy without off-target search.
    - findOffTargetsWithBulge = Logical; set to TRUE to search for off-targets with bulges using Cas-OFFinder.
    - annotateExon = Logical; set to TRUE to annotate if off-targets are within exons (requires txdb and orgAnn).
    - txdb = A TxDb object containing organism-specific annotation data, required for annotateExon.
    - orgAnn = An OrgDb object containing organism-specific annotation mapping, required for annotateExon.
    - scoring.method = Method for off-target scoring (e.g., "Hsu-Zhuang" or "CFDscore").
    - baseEditing = Logical; set to TRUE to design gRNAs for base editing (requires targetBase, editingWindow, and editingWindow.offtargets).
    - primeEditing = Logical; set to TRUE to design gRNAs for prime editing (requires specific PE parameters).
- alternatives:
    - Cas-OFFinder (via getOfftargetWithBulge() or findOffTargetsWithBulge = TRUE) is integrated for finding off-targets with DNA/RNA bulges.
    - GenomicFeatures and txdbmaker packages can be used to build custom TxDb objects if pre-built ones are not available.
- when_to_use:
    - Use when designing gRNAs for CRISPR-Cas9 or derivative systems (such as paired nickases, base editors, or prime editors) and evaluating their on-target efficacy and off-target profiles against a reference genome or custom genome.
- pitfalls:
    - Setting max.mismatch > 3 will significantly increase computation time.
    - Setting chromToSearch = "" disables both off-target search and gRNA efficacy calculation. To calculate efficacy without off-target search, specify the target chromosome and set max.mismatch = 0.
    - For very long sequences (>200 kb), set annotatePaired = FALSE and enable multicore processing (enable.multicore = TRUE) to avoid slow performance, and ensure repeat-masked sequences are used as input.
    - Using the "Root_RuleSet2_2016" efficacy rule set requires a local Python 2.7 installation with specific packages (scikit-learn 0.16.1, pandas, numpy, scipy) configured in the system path.

workflows.name: standard_offtarget_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify gRNAs in an input sequence, perform off-target analysis against a reference genome, and annotate off-targets.
workflows.stages:
1. Load required annotation and genome packages.
2. Run offTargetAnalysis with input sequence, BSgenome, TxDb, and OrgDb.
workflows.code:
library(CRISPRseek)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

inputFilePath <- system.file('extdata', 'inputseq.fa', package = 'CRISPRseek')
outputDir <- getwd()
res <- offTargetAnalysis(inputFilePath = inputFilePath,
                         BSgenomeName = Hsapiens,
                         chromToSearch= "chrX", 
                         
                         # Annotation packages required for annotation.
                         txdb = TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene, 
                         orgAnn = org.Hs.egSYMBOL,
                         
                         outputDir = outputDir,
                         overwrite = TRUE)
head(res$summary[, c("names", "gRNAsPlusPAM", "gRNAefficacy")])
head(res$offtarget[, c("name", "OffTargetSequence", "alignment", "score", "gRNAefficacy")])

workflows.name: bulge_offtarget_analysis
workflows.intent: Search for off-targets allowing DNA and RNA bulges using Cas-OFFinder.
workflows.stages:
1. Run offTargetAnalysis with findOffTargetsWithBulge = TRUE.
2. Alternatively, find gRNAs first using findgRNAs and then call getOfftargetWithBulge.
workflows.code:
library(CRISPRseek)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)

inputFilePath <- system.file('extdata', 'inputseq.fa', package = 'CRISPRseek')
outputDir <- getwd()

if (interactive()) {
  res <- offTargetAnalysis(inputFilePath = inputFilePath,
                         findOffTargetsWithBulge = TRUE,
                         BSgenomeName = Hsapiens,
                         chromToSearch = "chrX",
                         annotateExon = FALSE,
                         outputDir = outputDir,
                         overwrite = TRUE)
  head(res$offtarget[, c("name", "gRNAPlusPAM_bulge", "OffTargetSequence_bulge", "n.RNABulge", "n.DNABulge", "alignment")])
}

if (interactive()) {
  gRNA_PAM <- findgRNAs(inputFilePath = system.file("extdata",
                                                    "inputseq.fa",
                                                    package = "CRISPRseek"),
                        pairOutputFile = "testpairedgRNAs.xls",
                        findPairedgRNAOnly = TRUE)
  res <- getOfftargetWithBulge(gRNA_PAM,
                               BSgenomeName = Hsapiens, 
                               chromToSearch = "chrX")
  head(res)
}

workflows.name: allele_specific_grna_design
workflows.intent: Compare two sequences (differing by a SNP) to identify gRNAs that preferentially target one allele over the other.
workflows.stages:
1. Run compare2Sequences on the two input FASTA files.
2. Evaluate cleavage scores and score differences to select allele-specific gRNAs.
workflows.code:
library(CRISPRseek)

inputFile1Path <- system.file("extdata", "rs362331C.fa", package="CRISPRseek") 
inputFile2Path <- system.file("extdata", "rs362331T.fa", package="CRISPRseek") 
outputDir <- getwd()

res <- compare2Sequences(inputFile1Path,
                         inputFile2Path, 
                         outputDir = outputDir,
                         overwrite = TRUE)
head(res[, c("name", "gRNAPlusPAM", "scoreForSeq1", "scoreForSeq2", "gRNAefficacy", "scoreDiff")])

workflows.name: base_editing_grna_design
workflows.intent: Design gRNAs optimized for base editing systems (CBE or ABE).
workflows.stages: 1. Run offTargetAnalysis with baseEditing = TRUE and specify target base and editing windows.
workflows.code:
library(CRISPRseek)

inputFilePath <- system.file('extdata', 'inputseq.fa', package = 'CRISPRseek')
outputDir <- getwd()

res <- offTargetAnalysis(inputFilePath = inputFilePath,
                         chromToSearch = "",
                         baseEditing = TRUE,
                         targetBase = "C",
                         editingWindow = 4:8,
                         editingWindow.offtargets = 4:8,
                         outputDir = outputDir,
                         overwrite = TRUE)
res

workflows.name: prime_editing_grna_design
workflows.intent: Design gRNAs and pegRNAs for prime editing.
input: inputseq.fa (FASTA file containing target sequences) or a DNAStringSet object
workflows.stages: 1. Run offTargetAnalysis with primeEditing = TRUE and specify prime editing parameters (PBS length, RT template length, corrected sequence, etc.).
workflows.code:
library(CRISPRseek)

inputFilePath <- DNAStringSet("CCAGTTTGTGGATCCTGCTCTGGTGTCCTCCACACCAGAATCAGGGATCGAAAACTCATCAGTCGATGCGAGTCATCTAAATTCCGATCAATTTCACACTTTAAACG")
outputDir <- getwd()

res <- offTargetAnalysis(inputFilePath,
                         chromToSearch = "",
                         gRNAoutputName = "testPEgRNAs", # Required when inputFilePath is a DNAStringSet object.
                         primeEditing = TRUE,
                         targeted.seq.length.change = 0,
                         bp.after.target.end = 15,
                         PBS.length = 15,
                         RT.template.length = 8:30,
                         RT.template.pattern = "D$",
                         target.start = 20,
                         target.end = 20,
                         corrected.seq = "T",
                         findPairedgRNAOnly = TRUE,
                         paired.orientation = "PAMin",
                         outputDir = outputDir, 
                         overwrite = TRUE)
res
